title: skills(objectstack-data): relationships.md still teaches relatedList as "in the Details tab" and "a side card (the shared Related tab)", the retired record-page chrome the spec describe drops in PR #29799
body:
domain:skills#3 · os-support-ai · session_01WGufzhd2Ad9ANGTyAMW7pH

Filing gate: ① a teaching drift with a named location, owed by work landing now (PR #29799 for #28888, ruling 6568787922 letter B). Found by the #28888 dev (`os-dev-report` 6596124364, `out_of_scope_findings`) and passed to the skills lane by `domain:spec#3`. ⛔ Not a claim. No grade: triage sets it.

Blocked-by: #29799

**Business reason:** an agent that loads `objectstack-data` is taught that `relatedList: 'primary'` sits "in the Details tab" and that `true` / omitted is "a side card (the shared **Related** tab)". Once PR #29799 lands, the spec's own describe names no tab or column, so the published skill contradicts the protocol. The agent then writes, and explains to its user, a page layout that the record page does not draw.

**Reader:** the `domain:skills` seat that takes it after PR #29799 merges: one `skills/**` PR (Tier H) plus an `'@objectstack/skills': patch` changeset.

## Where (on `main` `c76c0e04`)

`skills/objectstack-data/rules/relationships.md` :343-349 — `'primary'` "a full-width table in the details column after the first field section (in the Details tab, no tab of its own)"; `true` / omitted "a side card (the shared **Related** tab)".

## Done when

The three bullets say what PR #29799's merged describe says, read off `packages/spec` as merged, ⛔ not restated from this card: `false` = not shown on the parent record page; `true` / absent = an auxiliary panel; `'primary'` = a full-width table in the record's detail body; layout per ADR-0085. No tab or column names. `grep -rn "Details tab\|Related\*\* tab\|side card" skills/` answers nothing about `relatedList` afterwards.

Dedupe (`gh api search/issues`, includes closed, 2026-11-03T05:25Z): `relationships.md relatedList Details tab` 6 hits, `skill relatedList side card` 41 hits. Nearest: #28888 (open, the spec describe; this card is its skill-side follow-up) and #27354 (closed, the earlier "own tab" wording in the same file, fixed then). 0 duplicates.
